text:
maya-support: Customer says they clicked promo link in activation email and UI shows 'Credit applied: $250', but their org balance and usage both remain unchanged. They provided org id org_8a7c and customer request id req_2026-03-16-01

sanjay: Can you paste the redemption payload and any webhook logs?

maya-support: Here's what they forwarded from the email click handler:
```
POST /api/v1/promos/redeem
{"code":"SPRING250","org_id":"org_8a7c","source":"email_link","request_id":"req_2026-03-16-01"}
200 OK
{"status":"accepted","grant_id":"grant_51b2","amount":250}
```

maya-support: UI shows confirmation screenshot and grant id grant_51b2. Customer sees confirmation email too.

olivia: I queried the ledger for org_8a7c and there's no ledger entry for grant_51b2. ledger search by request_id returns nothing.

devops-bot: webhook-delivery: POST /hooks/ledger/grants 2026-03-16T08:12:10Z status=202 body_digest=sha256:abc123

olivia: webhook shows 202 accepted to ledger-ingest but we see no ingestion success. Checking worker logs.

olivia: worker logs show transient DB timeout during ingest at 08:12:11Z -> retry scheduled. Later retry succeeded at 08:12:45Z with status 200 from ledger-ingest. But ledger ingestion id not linked to org_8a7c in mapping table. Investigating mapping job.

sanjay: Possible mapping key mismatch between grant_id and org_id? Did redemption flow use org alias instead of canonical id?

olivia: Good catch. Redemption payload had org_id org_8a7c (customer-facing). Internal ledger expects customer_id 0x8a7c (prefixed). Mapping service emits mapping.create events. Searching mapping logs for grant_51b2 shows mapping.create failed with 422 validation error: "unknown_org_id".

maya-support: Customer claims they recently migrated their org from org_8a7c -> org-legacy:8a7c last week. Could be related.

olivia: If mapping service rejects, ledger ingestion still accepted but orphaned grant isn't linked to an account. That explains UI confirmation (frontend mirrors grant response) but no balance update.

sanjay: Workaround for support: can we manually apply credit to canonical org id so customer gets balance while we fix mapping?

billing-service: We can create a manual adjustment. Need confirmed canonical id. Please hold while I look up org metadata.

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T09:01:00Z started by @sanjay for mapping-service hotfix branch fix/org-id-normalize

billing-service: Found canonical id customer_c_42 for org_8a7c. I can post a manual ledger credit: {"org":"customer_c_42","amount":250,"meta":{"source":"support-manual","ref":"grant_51b2"}}. Proceed? :warning:

maya-support: Customer is OK with manual apply. Please proceed and note we need to reconcile grant_51b2 mapping to avoid double-credit later.

billing-service: Manual credit posted 2026-03-16T09:08:12Z ledger_tx=tx_9922. Balance increased immediately. Customer confirmed seeing updated balance. :white_check_mark:

olivia: I'll follow up on mapping-service root cause. Initial hypothesis: org migration created alias but mapping table normalization didn't include hyphenated legacy ids. Patch in PR adds normalization and backfills alias -> canonical mapping for last 30 days.

sanjay: Nice. Plan: 1) backfill aliases for affected orgs 2) find orphaned grants and attach to canonical orgs or mark reconciled to avoid duplicate manual credits 3) add alert for mapping.create 422 spikes.

maya-support: I'll send customer note: we applied manual credit and engineering is backfilling mapping to attach the original grant. Apologize for the extra step.

olivia: Marking this thread escalated -> eng-billing. I'll drop reproducer steps: create promo redeem with alias org id after migration, observe accepted response but ledger mapping 422, verify orphaned grant in ledger DB, then backfill mapping to attach grant.

maya-support: Thanks team. Customer happy for now. Closing once backfill confirmed. :pray:
